core.timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) that core operations may take before timing out.

logging.log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use 'console' to log to stdout.

file.enabled.description: Whether to enable the file extension.

file.scan_directories.description: List of directories to scan for local media files.

file.scan_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for scanning local files.

file.scan_depth.description: Maximum directory depth to scan (0 = current dir only).

file.follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links during scanning.

http.enabled.description: Whether to enable the built-in HTTP server for web clients.

http.hostname.description: IP address or hostname for the HTTP server to bind to.

http.port.description: Port for the HTTP server to listen on.

http.allow_cors.description: Whether to allow Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) requests.

http.max_request_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of an HTTP request body.

stream.enabled.description: Whether to enable streaming of network radio and other remote sources.

stream.buffer_size.description: Size (in bytes) of the streaming buffer.

mpd.enabled.description: Whether to enable the MPD (Music Player Daemon) server.

mpd.max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous MPD client connections.

mpd.password.description: Password for MPD authentication (leave empty to disable).

spotify.username.description: Spotify username (required if Spotify is enabled).

spotify.password.description: Spotify password (required if Spotify is enabled).

spotify.timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for Spotify API calls.

spotify.offline.description: Whether to allow offline playback (requires premium subscription).

spotify.volume_normalization.description: Whether to normalize Spotify volume levels.

spotify.preferred_language.description: Preferred language for search results (ISO 639-1 code).

local.enabled.description: Whether to enable the local media backend.

local.media_dir.description: Directory containing local music files (same as [file] if shared).

local.data_dir.description: Directory for local metadata cache (e.g., album art).

local.max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent scanning workers.

local.scan_depth.description: Maximum directory depth to scan for local media.

local.scan_directories.description: List of directories to scan for local media files.

local.follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links during local scanning.

iris.enabled.description: Whether to enable the Iris web UI (requires Spotify).

iris.api_key.description: Optional API key for Iris premium features.

bandcamp.search_language.description: Language code for Bandcamp search results (ISO 639-1).
